title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 071
review_goal: Differentiate magic, magic hat, and AI message variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Magic wand bar with one top square tip and three sparkle stars around
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a plain wand bar with several separate sparkle stars around it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the star wand or burst wand when the wand should not cross a large symbol.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a simple wand bar surrounded by three separate sparkle stars.

items.depicts_observation: Wizard hat with a round brim and two sparkle stars above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a pointed wizard hat with sparkles floating above the brim.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the top hat when the opening should look flat and circular inside the brim.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a pointed hat resting on a round brim with two sparkle stars above.

items.depicts_observation: Top hat with one circular opening above a tapered lower body and sparkle stars
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a magician top hat with an open ring at the top and sparkles above.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the pointed wizard hat when the crown should rise into one sharp tip.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the hat into a top hat with an open top ring and a tapered body.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded message face with two centered dots and one sparkle star at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a rounded face like message mark with a sparkle at the upper right.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the text bubble AI mark when inner text bars should replace the face dots.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot combines a face like rounded message outline with a sparkle on the upper right.

items.depicts_observation: Text bubble frame with two inner bars and one sparkle star at upper right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a standard text bubble with sparkle rather than a face styled message.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the rounded face AI bubble when two dot eyes should appear inside the shape.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot uses a text bubble with inner bars and adds the sparkle at the upper right corner.
